title: Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities
summary: J. J. Hopfield published 'Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities' in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences in April 1982. The paper describes a neural-system model whose collective properties produce content-addressable memory and whose state evolution uses asynchronous parallel processing.
significance: A documented 1982 neural-network publication milestone concerning collective computation and content-addressable memory, represented strictly as a publication event rather than an invention, priority, ancestry, or causal claim.
